abstract: PURPOSE: We identified quantitative cutoff values for CT-based vascular proximity metrics and evaluated their associations with intraoperative complications and extent of resection. METHODS: We reviewed the records of 20 children who underwent retroperitoneal teratoma resection between 2005 and 2025. Using contrast-enhanced CT, we measured tumor-vessel contact length, counted the number of contacted major vessels, and assigned a vascular deformation score from 0 to 2. RESULTS: Intraoperative complications occurred in seven patients (35%). The contacted vessel count was significantly higher in patients with complications (p = 0.015), and contact length showed a similar trend (p = 0.056). Receiver operating characteristic analysis demonstrated good discrimination for contacted vessel count (AUC 0.838; cutoff 3) and contact length (AUC 0.769; cutoff 58.8 mm). Complication rates were highest when the contacted vessel count was ≥ 3 and contact length was ≥ 60 mm. Complete resection was achieved in 15 patients (75%), and subtotal resection was associated with a higher vascular deformation score (p = 0.029). CONCLUSION: Preoperative CT-based vascular proximity assessment helped estimate surgical difficulty in pediatric retroperitoneal teratoma. A contacted vessel count ≥ 3 and contact length ≥ 60 mm indicated higher complication risk, whereas a higher vascular deformation score was associated with subtotal resection.
abstract_ja:
目的: CTに基づく血管近接指標のカットオフ値を同定し、術中合併症および切除範囲との関連を評価すること。
方法: 2005年から2025年の間に後腹膜奇形腫の切除を受けた小児20例の記録を後方視的に検討した。造影CTを用いて腫瘍と血管の接触長を計測し、接触した主要血管数を数え、0〜2の血管変形スコアを付与した。
結果: 7例(35%)に術中合併症が生じた。合併症例では接触血管数が有意に多く(p=0.015)、接触長も同様の傾向を示した(p=0.056)。ROC解析では、接触血管数(AUC 0.838、カットオフ3)および接触長(AUC 0.769、カットオフ58.8mm)で良好な識別能が示された。接触血管数が3以上かつ接触長が60mm以上の場合に合併症率が最も高かった。15例(75%)で完全切除が達成された。亜全摘は血管変形スコアの高さと関連していた(p=0.029)。
結論: 術前のCTに基づく血管近接評価は、小児後腹膜奇形腫の手術難易度の推定に役立つ。接触血管数3以上、接触長60mm以上は合併症リスクの上昇を示し、血管変形スコアの高さは亜全摘と関連していた。
